title: Juicy Bitter Thai Tomato Curry
description: A midnightcraving Thai dish that balances the bitterness of tomatoes with caramelized aromatics and a lowsodium kick.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium‑high heat. Add sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 3‑4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and grated ginger, sautéing for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add Thai red curry paste, cooking for one more minute and stirring to coat the aromatics.
Pour in diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, letting them soften and release juices.
Add vegetable broth and coconut milk, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in tamarind paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar (if using). Simmer for 10 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and the sauce to thicken slightly.
Add lime juice, taste, and adjust seasoning if needed. Simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, transfer to serving bowls, and garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Serve with steamed jasmine rice or warm naan.
